purpose: Teach: 備蓄/修繕/調印/共催/譲る/過労/堅実/組み込ん

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 非常用の備蓄、各事業所、点検しろ。
lines.en: Check the emergency stockpiles at each branch.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative. Direct eye contact. No softening — this is an order, not a suggestion. Breath control and pace keep it matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本社ビル、修繕、来月から始まります。
lines.en: Understood. The renovation of the main office building starts next month.
lines.style: Respectful, slightly faster than the boss. Not hurried — organized. Small nod of confirmation. Reporting facts clearly without embellishment or hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 契約、調印は、今週金曜の予定だな。
lines.en: The contract signing is scheduled for Friday this week, yes?
lines.style: Measured confirmation. Light vocal rise at the end, checking alignment. Not demanding — expecting agreement from someone who should already know this.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界団体と、共催イベント、企画中です。
lines.en: Yes. We're currently planning a co-hosted event with the industry association.
lines.style: Steady, informative. Each item gets equal weight. No excitement — professional update delivered with competence. Eyes stay level.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今回の案件、若手に譲る判断、する。
lines.en: For this project, I've decided to give the younger staff members the lead.
lines.style: Calm announcement of a decision already made. Slight pause before the decision itself. Not asking for input — stating direction with quiet confidence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。過労、社員の中で、注意喚起しております。
lines.en: Understood. We're actively reminding the team about overwork and burnout prevention.
lines.style: Affirmative, slightly earnest. Shows he takes the instruction seriously. A beat of care in his voice — this matters beyond just compliance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 堅実な経営方針、社内、徹底しろ。
lines.en: Implement sound management practices consistently throughout the company.
lines.style: Direct, non-negotiable. Each word has weight. Deliberate pace. The tone of someone who expects compliance and will notice if it doesn't happen.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新システムを組み込んだ運用、来期、開始します。
lines.en: Understood. We'll begin operations with the new system integrated starting next quarter.
lines.style: Clear confirmation and timeline. Professional formality. Slight lift of pride in 'will begin' — showing readiness and preparedness. Measured, not rushed.
